independence.authoring_basis: independently written operational outcomes using only v12 function IDs, intent IDs, and S/C classes
independence.label_access_policy: frozen non-tuning holdout; outcomes and misses are not inputs to catalog tuning

independence.near_copy_policy: same-locale goals are pairwise checked after Unicode normalization; exact, wrapped, and high-similarity copies are rejected
